title: FlowDoc Creator UX and Database Alignment v0 Checklist

items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, role, phase, checklist, evidence target, risks, and unknown state.
items.evidenceTarget: The alignment record identifies Project Control ownership before writing creator UX and v0.0.2 database framing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-document-structure-database-model > flowdoc-creator-ux-db-alignment-v0, owner repo-project-control, active role planning-partner with documentation-authority-steward and evidence-registrar responsibilities, phase target phase-flowdoc-creator-ux-db-alignment-v0, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-creator-ux-db-alignment-v0, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-creator-ux-db-alignment-v0-2026-09-04.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard before adding the creator UX and v0.0.2 database records.
items.evidenceTarget: A focused records test fails before Project Control contains the alignment Work, documents, checklist, and evidence records.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-creator-ux-db-alignment-v0.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because flowdoc-document-structure-database-model did not yet include flowdoc-creator-ux-db-alignment-v0 as a child Work.

items.label: Define the creator flow from Document Structure Library through Build, Preview, Versions, and Published/API.
items.evidenceTarget: The Creator UX Contract v0 document defines the authoring and simulation split.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-creator-ux-contract-v0-2026-09-04.md defines Document Structure Library -> Build -> Preview -> Versions -> Published/API, with Build as draft authoring and Preview as simulation.

items.label: Define Structure Pattern Slot as author-time relationship and Structure Pattern Entry as Preview or runtime occurrence.
items.evidenceTarget: The UX and database documents state that Build defines the slot and Preview or runtime creates the entries.
items.verificationNote: Both alignment documents separate Structure Pattern, Structure Pattern Slot, and Structure Pattern Entry so future rooms do not treat Build as placing repeated runtime copies.

items.label: Define the v0.0.2 database relationship model for slots, fields, bindings, version freeze, and publication pointer behavior.
items.evidenceTarget: The v0.0.2 document defines draft_structure_pattern_slots, document_version_structure_pattern_slots, draft_fields, document_version_fields, document_version_bindings, repeat policy, layout boundary fields, and slot-driven freeze.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-document-structure-database-model-v0-0-2-2026-09-04.md defines the slot-driven v0.0.2 relationship model and keeps record_json as derived/cache material rather than canonical truth.

items.label: Exclude runtime submissions, submitted values, generated files, permissions, audit, workflow, billing, integrations, and product implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: The documents keep runtime Structure Pattern Entries and product repository implementation outside this Project Control planning round.
items.verificationNote: The alignment documents state that Runtime Structure Pattern Entries are out of scope and that no Core, Backend, or Editor files change in this phase.

items.label: Verify Project Control records, generated read model, and checks.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused records guard, generated read model, Project Control data validation, and full Project Control checks pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-creator-ux-db-alignment-v0.test.ts --maxWorkers=1, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
